summary: sm-session preinstall exfiltrates host identity and full environment to hardcoded IP
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs curl against the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://16.192.173.5/rce/sm-session, sending the installer's hostname, whoami, pwd, and id outputs together with a base64-encoded dump of the entire process environment (env | base64). This fires automatically on npm install, before any user code runs. The bulk environment dump routinely contains CI/CD tokens, cloud credentials (AWS/GCP/Azure), npm/GitHub tokens, and database passwords, all of which are transmitted over plain HTTP to an attacker-controlled destination unrelated to any legitimate publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
